presentationColumns.name: Week Start Date
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product Weekly Performance.Week Start Date
presentationColumns.description: Week represented by the product weekly mart row. Include this field when analyzing trends or when you do not want weekly product measures to blend across the season.

presentationColumns.name: Date Key
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product Weekly Performance.Date Key
presentationColumns.description: Hidden date key used to join the product weekly mart to the Date dimension.

presentationColumns.name: SKU ID
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product Weekly Performance.SKU ID
presentationColumns.description: Hidden SKU key used to join the product weekly mart to the Product dimension.

presentationColumns.name: Collection ID
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product Weekly Performance.Collection ID
presentationColumns.description: Hidden collection key used to join the product weekly mart to the Collection dimension.

presentationColumns.name: Sales Line Count
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product Weekly Performance.Sales Line Count
presentationColumns.description: Sales line activity aggregated to product-week grain.

presentationColumns.name: Transaction Count
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product Weekly Performance.Transaction Count
presentationColumns.description: Distinct transaction activity represented in the product-week mart.

presentationColumns.name: Units Sold
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product Weekly Performance.Units Sold
presentationColumns.description: Same underlying sales quantity as the core Units Sold KPI, aggregated into the product-week mart. Use this for SKU/week trend analysis, moving averages, sell-through behavior, and product performance diagnostics.

presentationColumns.name: Full Price Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product Weekly Performance.Full Price Units
presentationColumns.description: Units sold at full price for the selected product-week context.

presentationColumns.name: Full Price Line Count

presentationColumns.description: Sales lines sold at full price for the selected product-week context.

presentationColumns.description: Product-week sales amount before discounts and markdowns.

presentationColumns.name: Discount Amount
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product Weekly Performance.Discount Amount
presentationColumns.description: Product-week discount or markdown value.

presentationColumns.name: Net Sales Amount
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product Weekly Performance.Net Sales Amount
presentationColumns.description: Net sales aggregated into product-week grain. Use this when comparing product weekly performance; use the core Sales KPIs folder for general revenue reporting by customer, channel, or promotion.

presentationColumns.name: Cost Amount
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product Weekly Performance.Cost Amount

presentationColumns.name: Returned Units

presentationColumns.description: Returned units associated with the product-week context.

presentationColumns.name: Return Line Count

presentationColumns.description: Return lines associated with the product-week context.

presentationColumns.name: Refund Amount
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product Weekly Performance.Refund Amount
presentationColumns.description: Refund amount associated with returned product-week units.

presentationColumns.name: Product-Week On Hand Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product Weekly Performance.Product-Week On Hand Units
presentationColumns.description: On-hand inventory aggregated into product-week grain. Use this as product trend context; use base inventory snapshot or movement folders for operational store-SKU inventory analysis.

presentationColumns.name: Product-Week Available Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product Weekly Performance.Product-Week Available Units
presentationColumns.description: Available inventory aggregated into product-week grain. Use this beside weekly sell-through and demand indices to explain product trend behavior.

presentationColumns.name: Product-Week Reserved Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product Weekly Performance.Product-Week Reserved Units
presentationColumns.description: Reserved inventory aggregated into product-week grain.

presentationColumns.description: Number of store-SKU inventory snapshots contributing to the product-week context.

presentationColumns.name: Inventory Value At Cost

presentationColumns.name: Average Weeks Of Supply

presentationColumns.name: Source Inventory Stockout Risk Score

presentationColumns.name: Net Sales 4W Avg

presentationColumns.name: Return Rate 4W Avg

presentationColumns.name: Demand Index 13W
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product Weekly Performance.Demand Index 13W

presentationColumns.name: Stockout Risk Score
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product Weekly Performance.Stockout Risk Score
presentationColumns.description: Average product-week stockout risk across the selected context. Useful for trend context, but for exception severity prefer current, latest, or peak risk measures where available.

presentationColumns.name: Overstock Risk Score
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product Weekly Performance.Overstock Risk Score
presentationColumns.description: Average product-week overstock risk across the selected context. Useful for trend context, but for exception severity prefer current, latest, or peak risk measures where available.

presentationColumns.name: Current Product Stockout Risk Score
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product Weekly Performance.Current Product Stockout Risk Score
presentationColumns.description: Latest-week product stockout risk in the current query context. This is product-week focused and not store-aware; use Product AI Signals for store-SKU-week exception cases.

presentationColumns.name: Current Product Overstock Risk Score
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product Weekly Performance.Current Product Overstock Risk Score
presentationColumns.description: Latest-week product overstock risk in the current query context. This is product-week focused and not store-aware; use Product AI Signals for store-SKU-week exception cases.

presentationColumns.name: Activity Count
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product Weekly Performance.Activity Count
presentationColumns.description: Activity flag count used to identify product-weeks with meaningful movement.

presentationColumns.name: Scenario Tag
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Product Weekly Performance.Scenario Tag
presentationColumns.description: Internal data-generation scenario marker; hidden from business-facing analysis.
